overall_summary: Husband-Wife / Married relationship topics significantly outperform generic family or poetry videos, driving over 10x the average views. Sister and pure poetry/shayari topics consistently struggle.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,767 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात...' (1,674 views) are the top 2 highest performing videos by a wide margin.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on real-life married relationship conflicts, unsaid emotional gaps, and daily marital empathy.

weak_patterns.evidence: Poetry video 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा' got 19 views; Sister videos got 19 and 138 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract/poetic lines without a grounded, everyday scenario or relatable household relationship conflict.
